channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-10-09 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 285¢/lb — down 1.2% on the week and down 9.6% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 17 sessions. Rainfall in the Central Highlands is running above its seasonal norm (+1.4σ) — favorable moisture for the robusta belt. The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is elevated. A strengthening Brazilian real (-2.2% in a month) squeezes producer margins — supportive for prices.
